tei:div.tei:p:
True and firm and established and everlasting and upright and faithful and pleasant and precious and delightful and glorious and awe-inspiring and powerful and ordered and favoured and good and comely is this word for us for ever and ever. In truth He is the God of the world, our King, the Rock of Jacob, the shield of our salvation. From generation
to generation does He endure and His Name endures, His throne is firmly founded and His realm and His faithfulness endure for ever. And His words are living and eternal, faithful and delightful always and in all eternity for our fathers and for us, for our children and our coming generations and all the generations of the seed of Israel Thy servants.

For the first and the last it is a good and everlasting word, truth and faithfulness, a statute that never passes away. It is truth that Thou, O Lord, art our God and the God of our fathers, our King, the King of our fathers, our Redeemer, the Redeemer of our fathers, our Creator, the Rock of our salvation, our deliverer and rescuer, that is Thy Name since eternity, there is no God except Thee.

The aid of our fathers hast Thou ever been, shield and helper of their children after them in every generation. In the heights of the world is Thy dwelling and Thy judgments and Thy love extend to the ends of the earth. Fortunate the man, who listens to Thy commandments and takes Thy Torah and Thy word to heart. In truth Thou art the Lord for Thy people and a strong King to promote their cause. In truth Thou art the first and Thou art the last and except for Thee we have no King, Redeemer or helper. From Egypt hashast Thou redeemed us, O Lord our God, and from the house of slaves hast Thou freed us. All their first born hast Thou slain and Thy first born redeemed, divided the Sea of Reeds, drowned the arrogant and led those dear to Thee through to safety. Then the waters covered their enemies, not one of them remained. Thereupon those who were loved, sang and praised God and those dear to Him offered hymns of praise, songs and glorification, blessings and thanks to the King, the living, eternal God. Lofty and exalted, great and awe-inspiring, He lowers the proud, raises the lowly, leads prisoners to freedom, redeems the meek, helps the poor and hears His people at the time when they implore Him. PraiscsPraises to the supreme God, blessed is He and called blessed. Moses and the children of Israel intoned a song to Thee with great rejoicing and all of them said:

tei:p.tei:seg: Who is like Thee among the powers, O Lord, who is like Thee, glorified in holiness, awe-inspiring in fame, worker of wonders.

tei:div.tei:p: The redeemed sang a new song in praise of Thy Name at the edge of the sea, together they all gave thanks and paid homage and said: the Lord reigns for ever and ever.

Rock of Israel, rise to the help of Israel and redeem according to Thine utterance Judah and Israel. Our Redeemer, the Lord of Hosts is His Name, the Holy One of Israel. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who has redeemed Israel.
